subLocations.name: Citadel Gate
subLocations.lore: The city gate that separated [[Watch Citadel]] and its surrounding district from the rest of the [[Upper City]].

subLocations.name: Gond Gate
subLocations.lore: One of the city's landmark "[[patriar]] gates."

subLocations.name: Manor Gate
subLocations.lore: A landmark gate in the old wall that separated the [[Upper City]] district of [[Manorborn]] from the [[Lower City]] district of [[Bloomridge]].

subLocations.name: Sea Gate
subLocations.lore: A landmark and one of the city's four, generally lesser well-known, "[[patriar]] gates" that connected the poor [[Lower City]] to the [[Upper City]].

subLocations.name: Baldur's Gate
subLocations.lore: One of the oldest landmarks and the eponymous city gate that gave the famed port metropolis of the [[Sword Coast]] its name.

subLocations.name: Heap Gate
subLocations.lore: One of the city's four, smaller "[[patriar]] gates" that connected the poorer [[Lower City]] to the affluent [[Upper City]].

subLocations.name: Black Dragon Gate
subLocations.lore: Also known as the '''Landward Gate''', the grand northward gate that allowed a passageway through the northern wall of [[Baldur's Gate]], decorated with a large stone sculpture of a [[black dragon]] head that loomed over the inner side of the wall.

subLocations.name: Basilisk Gate
subLocations.lore: The landmark gate lined with statues of prominent deceased [[patriar]], including one of [[Entar Silvershield]] placed above the gate in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

subLocations.name: Cliffgate
subLocations.lore: A landmark gate that served as a passageway connecting the [[Lower City]] to the isolated district of [[Tumbledown]] in the [[Outer City]].
